# Pytest paths that repo-checks runs on every backend-affecting PR, outside test
# selection. List a path here when its tests take the whole repo as input (the
# INSTALLED_APPS import graph, signal registries, repo-wide AST scans), so any
# file in the repo can break them while the diff touches nothing they appear to
# own. Product isolation and draft narrowing skip the Django suite for exactly
# such diffs, which is how a product-only PR turned master red without a single
# failing check.
# New guards belong in posthog/test/repo_invariants/, which the entry below
# picks up automatically; list another path only when a guard can't live there.
# Only list tests that pass with no Postgres, ClickHouse, or Redis available:
# repo-checks runs without service containers.
posthog/test/repo_invariants
